title: アタシのタイマン、アンタのタイマン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon is doing everything in her power to prepare for the Oka Sho, and I work on several new training regimens to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We toil day after day, working together—and Hishi Amazon grows in leaps and bounds as a result of our efforts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her trust in me as her partner deepens when she sees how dedicated I am to her cause. Meanwhile, the Oka Sho looms on the horizon…
